name: Wacky Star
source: Kyoden was having a normal day... at first. But then a bunch of weird things start to happen to him! Why do... so many boys like him all of a sudden?! AND SOME AREN'T EVEN SUPPOSED TO BE REAL!!! What will Kyoden do with the power of LOVE?
